coordinate_convention: Zero-based row-major indices; rect=[x,y,width,height], bbox/crop endpoints exclusive. All geometry uses source pixels, not game logical display units.

processing.assembly: First normalized half followed by its horizontal reflection. No hand-painted pixels or procedural scenery.
processing.reason: Guarantees a continuous scroll seam at both the center and the outer repeat boundary; object-free cut regions prevent doubled clipped objects.

visual_review.seam_preview: Two complete tiles placed side by side and viewed; matched boundary pixels and no height discontinuity.

limits: Seamless repeat is obtained by technical mirrored tile assembly, not an assertion that the original generated left and right edges matched.
Actual build-43 rendering and scrolling were not executed.

art_notes.creation: Built-in imagegen, reference creature_book.png for cozy pixel-art style only.
technical_processing: Resize the complete 1254x1254 atlas uniformly to1024x1024 with nearest-neighbor.
Translate every cell in a given row by the same dx,dy to place the stationary roots on y247. No per-frame bounding-box scaling or centering.

loop.review_scope: All16 frames visually inspected and four-frame animation preview created. Loop is a discrete four-pose animation, not interpolated motion; runtime timing and mobile renderer were not tested.

art_notes.processing: Imagegen corrected the bubble count to four per cell; only the corrected top row is inserted. Other five source rows are preserved except magenta key normalization and vertical bottom-anchor registration for crab/clam cells. No per-frame scale or horizontal recentering.

rows.world_motion: Translate instance upward over time; sprite phase alone is not the whole rise.

Leftward drift; the three fish are one kind9 instance.
Small bob is already in artwork; do not cancel by per-frame bbox recentering or double its amplitude.
Static floor reward clam. Drive states by stored pearl event. Hold frame2 during valid pickup window; no autonomous reward or endless open-loop.

processing: RGB conversion and near-magenta key normalization

visual_review.starfish: Exactly five arms, orange palette, friendly face, lower arm baselines aligned. Small arm-tip changes with constant body scale.
visual_review.boxfish: Yellow squared body, brown spots and turquoise fins; left-facing head and right-facing tail in all frames. Not inflated or spiny.
visual_review.ray: Small teal ray with pale belly and light spots, left-facing snout and long right tail; fins alternate neutral/raised/neutral/lowered.
visual_review.consistency: All frame directions and identities inspected; no water, sand, panels, text or numerals.
visual_review.loop_scope: Four-frame slow loops reviewed at atlas level and exported as GIF. Small shape/redraw variations are part of generated animation; not a rigged or in-app runtime animation test.

animation_proposal.body_world_translation: Handled by app; do not translate the atlas frames again to infer movement. Starfish remains grounded; swimming travel direction is left.

Full four-column strip nearest resized, near-black max RGB<=12 normalized to pure black; no per-frame crop or recentering.
art_notes.compositing: Pure-black key removal or screen/additive blending. Never remove black outlines from other art. Daytime only; retain existing night overlay.
